_why: Every saint searched for an icon and refused, with the reason. The icon queue is DERIVED — `node scripts/heroless.mjs romanian greek russian serbian`, the distinct hero-saints, minus the slugs in here — because a static list of names written into TODO.md was deleted by a later rewrite of that item and the next wave had to rebuild the queue from scratch. A refusal is as valuable as an icon and it is the half that was being lost.

_kinds.floor: below the ~450px thumbnail floor; make_thumbs.py never upscales
_kinds.namesake: the file names a different saint of the same name
_kinds.named-after: something named after the saint rather than the saint
_kinds.event-or-group: an event, or a group image that does not name him
_kinds.ambiguous: an identification a reader cannot check off the picture
_kinds.nothing: nothing on Commons names the saint by any of the four routes
_kinds.nowhere: nothing on Commons, Wikidata structured data, el/ro/ru/sr/bg wikipedia, Openverse or Europeana — scratchpad/icon-sweep.py, 14 October 2026

_note: A refusal is not permanent: Commons gains files. `floor` and `nothing` are worth retrying after a long gap; `namesake` and `ambiguous` want a reading rather than another search.

route 1's namespace-14 search on acacius/kausokalyvite returns nothing, route 2 reports no Wikidata hit, and the hand aliases Category:Akakios Kausokalyvitis and Category:Acacius of Kafsokalyvia are both empty. The folder stores only Greek and Serbian forms, so route 3 cannot be run at all.

no category under panagis/basias, no Wikidata hit, and both hand aliases Category:Panagis Bassias and Category:Panagis Basias are empty. The Kephalonian priest-fool died in 1888 so a photograph would be out of copyright, but nothing is on Commons. No Russian form stored, so route 3 is unavailable.

the Athonite of 9 July, kept with his disciple Metrophanes: nothing under dionysius/rhetor, no Wikidata hit, Category:Dionysios the Rhetor empty. Romanian and Greek forms only, so route 3 is unavailable.

nothing under anthony/veria, no Wikidata hit, Category:Anthony the New of Veria empty. Romanian and Greek forms only, so route 3 is unavailable. A bare 'Anthony' search is the forename trap and was not run.

he is one of the Nine Martyrs of Cyzicus and route 3 reaches their category: Category:Nine martyrs of Kizikos holds «Жития Святых (1903-1911) - икона 08291 9 мучеников» at 1408x1783, whose plate code 08291 resolves to the Julian 29 April, this folder's own feast. The plate identity rule needs both halves and only the date half holds — the title names «9 мучеников» and not «Артема», so nothing in the picture is him rather than any of the other eight. The category's one named single figure is «Далматий Кизический», a different one of the nine, at 300x407.

route 1 found no category, route 2 no entity, and route 3's full-text search on «Христина Персидская» returns Christina of Sweden and nothing else. The Persian martyr of 13 March has nothing on Commons under any of the three.

no category, no Wikidata entity, and route 3 on «Захария Отверстый» returns the 6 April date page, the wolf and the murder of Rasputin — the full-text search is matching on «отверстый» rather than on the saint. Nothing on Commons names the Scetis monk.

«Euthalia» on Wikidata is a genus of nymphalid butterfly and every hit is a species of it, six entities deep; route 3 on «Евфалия Леентинская (Сицилийская)» returns only the 15 March date page. The Sicilian martyr of Lentini has nothing, and the butterflies are what a free-text search would hand a careless sourcer.

«Thalassius» on Wikidata is a genus of fishing spider, whose Commons category holds no image files anyway, and route 3 on «Фалассий Сирийский» returns nothing at all. The Syrian hermit of 22 February has nothing on Commons.

no category, no Wikidata entity, and route 3 on «Меласипп Анкирский» returns only the «20 ноября» date page. He is kept with his wife Casinia and son Antoninus and nothing on Commons names any of the three.

route 3 on «Феофил Новый, Константинопольский» returns John Chrysostom, Meletius Smotrytsky, the Luís I bridge and the emperor Theophilos with his empress Theodora — the search is matching the name Феофил, not the soldier-martyr. No category and no entity for the admiral martyred under the Arabs, kept 30 January.

«Taurion» on Wikidata is a river in France and a bolete; route 3 reports no ru.wikipedia article for «Таврион Амфипольский (Македонский)» at all. He is kept 7 November with Melasippus's company and the Thirty-Three of Melitene and nothing on Commons names him.

the Georgian confessor who died at Betania in 1957: no Wikidata entity under «Иоанн (Майсурадзе)», and route 3's full-text search returns his Betania companions Gabriel Urgebadze and Lazar Abashidze, who have categories, and a figure-skating championship. His own likeness would be a 20th-century photograph and none is on Commons.

all three routes dry: no category built from the folder's names, no Wikidata entity for «Артемон Селевкийский», and route 3's ru.wikipedia full-text returns the «6 апреля» date page and an 18th-c. Hamilton genealogy. The deacon of Seleucia kept 24 March has nothing on Commons.

the folder stores the bare «Афанасия», so route 3's full-text search can only return Athanasius the Great and Afanasy Nikitin the merchant traveller, which is what it did; no Wikidata entity and no category. The bare forename is the reason this one cannot be reached rather than evidence that nothing exists, and it is worth retrying if the folder ever gains a by-named form.

no category, no Wikidata entity, and route 3 on «Христина Лампсакийская» returns nothing at all. She is kept 18 May with Peter and Paul of Lampsacus, whose folders are refused here on the same day for the same reason.

the folder stores the bare «Евдокия», so route 3 returns the given name, the children of Ivan IV and Eudoxia Lopukhina, Peter I's first wife; no Wikidata entity and no category. Unreachable for want of a by-name rather than demonstrably absent.
no Wikidata entity under «Евдоксий», and route 3 finds no ru.wikipedia article under the folder's forms. One of the Melitene martyrs of 6 September; nothing on Commons names him apart from the group.

no Wikidata entity, and route 3 on «Иоанн Психаит» returns the Byzantine Iconoclasm article and the given-name category, neither with an image of him. The iconodule confessor of the Psycha monastery, kept 7 June, has nothing on Commons.

no Wikidata entity under «Николай (Симо)», and route 3 returns the painter Nikolay Ge, the emperor Nicholas I and the town of Sim in Chelyabinsk Oblast — the search is matching Николай and Сим separately. A 20th-century figure whose likeness would be a photograph, and none is on Commons.

the folder stores «Павел Коринфянин» and route 3 therefore returns the Apostle Paul, 1 and 2 Corinthians and their papyri — not this martyr. No Wikidata entity and no category. The Apostle's whole apparatus standing in front of a homonymous martyr is the forename trap in its Russian form.

no Wikidata entity under «Петр Лампсакский», and route 3 returns Aristotle, the Lyceum, the Platonic Academy and the First Council of Nicaea — Lampsacus is matching Anaximenes' and Strato's city, not the martyr. Nothing on Commons.

no Wikidata entity under «Феодор Африканский», and route 3 returns the Patriarchal Exarchate of Africa and Theodore II of Alexandria, both modern. One of the forty companions of Terentius kept 10 April; nothing on Commons names him singly. NOTE: this slug is also where m1ru.py crashed with HTTP 414 — see the `_note` on that instrument.
